 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH
ORAL ORDER 3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Banka P.S. Case No. 47 of 2024 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 120(B) of Indian Penal Code and Section 10 of Bihar Conduct of Examination Act, 1981.
3. As per the prosecution case, on 06.02.2024 the informant was posted as Centre Superintendent at Sarvajanik Inter College, Sarvodya Nagar Banka.

entities.text: Sarvajanik Inter College, Sarvodya Nagar Banka
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: During supervision it was found that, in place of Prince Kumar (Petitioner) another student namely Suman Kumar was appearing in the examination.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is quite innocent and has committed no Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.50286 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 offence and has been falsely implicated in this case due to local politics.
The allegation brought against the petitioner is false and baseless.
The petitioner has no knowledge about who is appearing in the examination on behalf of him.
Due to illness the petitioner could not appear in the examination.
Learned counsel further submits that petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and also submits that charge-sheet has already been submitted in this case.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, in Prince Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183534962/
1 the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Banka in connection with Banka P.S. Case No. 47 of 2024, subject to conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of the B.N.S.S, with further condition:-
(i) Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be present on each and every fixed date till framing of charge and Patna High Court CR.
